description: Department of Labour - Notify the Special Allowance payable to workers in the Cocoa, Cardamom and Pepper growing and manufacturing trade
reasoning: This gazette notification announces a special allowance for workers based on the Cost of Living Index Number, issued under Section 20(2)(b) of the Wages Boards Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory matter involving statutory instruments and compliance requirements for specific trades, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
